statement: A gap is registered only with dated retrieval attempts. No data point in this library was ever filled in from a source that is not archived under series/*/source/.

gaps.target: Lindqvist (1989), 'A straightforward method for calculation of ice resistance of ships', POAC'89 -- the original resistance table and its constant set
gaps.why_needed: the 15 % verdict is currently taken against a *second-hand* transcription of the Lindqvist column (Hu & Zhou 2016, Table 8). Without the original the report cannot say whether the platform's Lindqvist branch or the source's transcription is the deviating one
gaps.unblock: POAC proceedings volume (paper-level PDF) or a library scan of the 1989 paper; table rows can be appended as a new series under measured_dataset/v1 without code changes
affects: parameter provenance of the bending closure

gaps.target: Riska (1997) level-ice resistance formulation and the Kämäräinen/Riska test tables
gaps.why_needed: the second published law family used as a cross-check; without the original its predictions stay second-hand as well, so a systematic transcription error could hide in both columns at once
gaps.unblock: Transport Canada / NRC report scan (TP 13110 series) or a university library copy

attempts.error: URLError: <urlopen error [Errno -2] Name or service not known>

attempts.what: Riska 1997 via NRC/Transport Canada landing page

gaps.target: Publisher PDF of Hu & Zhou (2016), Int. J. Naval Arch. Ocean Eng. 8(2) 169-176 (DOI 10.1016/j.ijnaoe.2016.01.004)
gaps.why_needed: series MTUIKKU-HZ2016 is the only series in the 15 % verdict set with measured resistance, and its digits currently come from an archived in-ecosystem transcription. Verification against the publisher PDF is the difference between 'MEASURED-PRIMARY' and 'MEASURED-PRIMARY via a secondary source'
gaps.unblock: the article is gold OA (OpenAlex is_oa=true): the single blocking step is fetching https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2092678215300133/pdf from an unfiltered host. One download closes the gap permanently because the tables are already transcribed and dual-entered
affects: C2 double entry (currently cannot check against the original)

attempts.what: Hu & Zhou (2016) DOI landing page (series A primary source)
OpenAlex OA-status record for the series A DOI
Gold-OA PDF endpoint reported by OpenAlex (Elsevier ScienceDirect)

gaps.target: A second test campaign with a *downward-bending* hull and measured resistance at >= 4 ice thicknesses (a different ship and basin than MT Uikku)
gaps.why_needed: with one campaign the FAIL verdict cannot be separated from a campaign-specific bias; the closure constant k_bend has no out-of-sample series to be validated on, which is exactly why the k_bend calibration of m9425 stays applied_to_validated_model=False
gaps.unblock: an OA thesis/paper with digitised level-ice resistance tables for a second hull; the upward-bending campaign ingested in this node (SALMI2014-UBIB) is independent but outside the downward-bending envelope, so it sharpens external validity without closing this gap
affects: out-of-sample validation of any closure re-calibration

attempts.what: Aalto DA (DSpace 7 REST) discover query: level ice resistance model tests

partial_progress.what_it_closes: a second, independent measured campaign (different hull, different breaking mode, different decade of the same basin)
partial_progress.what_it_does_not_close: downward-bending coverage; the concept hull bends ice upwards
